GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-11-07T06:47:26Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Language Key from .m3u8 file doesn't match language key in track group
Description: In my .m3u8 file, I have a track for subtitles in Indonesian, with language key "id". 
It looks like this: 
`#EXT-X-MEDIA:TYPE=SUBTITLES,GROUP-ID="subs",NAME="Indonesian",DEFAULT=NO,AUTOSELECT=YES,FORCED=NO,LANGUAGE="id",URI="main_id.m3u8"`

After it's parsed into the player's track group, the language key is "ms-ind-d"
It looks like this: 
`Format(subs:Indonesian _ Indonesia, Indonesian _ Indonesia, application/x-mpegURL, text/vtt, null, -1, ms-ind-id, [-1, -1, -1.0], [-1, -1])`

The same thing happens with Norwegian. The language key in the .m3u8 file is "nb", but when it's parsed by the player, it becomes "no-nob".

Why does this happen?
